name: PRS-on-phenotype outlier test (POPout)
model_likelihood: Linear regression of standardized PRS on standardized residualized continuous trait
inference_algorithm: Fit PRS-on-trait regression; test tail residual means by two-tailed t-tests; screen middle centiles for nonlinearity
estimand: Signed tail mean prediction error and tail-specific tests of zero residual mean
data_input: Individual target-sample PRS and continuous trait residuals; upstream PRS uses base GWAS and target genotypes
tunable_settings: Tail quantile (1% per tail in primary analysis); ten upstream PRS association thresholds; QC middle 80 centiles and Bonferroni familywise level 0.05

name: Sibling tail architecture omnibus test (STANDout)
inference_algorithm: Estimate h2 by sibling-pair null maximum likelihood; combine Mendelian and de novo component P values with Fisher statistic
estimand: Omnibus tail departure from common-variant architecture due to segregating or de novo high-effect alleles
data_input: Paired index and conditional sibling trait values; trait-tail quantile
